steps.content: You grip Helene's hand tightly as you both follow the guard evacuating toward the far end of the manor.
The world shudders without cease, and soon, the thick, choking smoke swallows the entire corridor.
The relentless thunder of explosions confirms it: the main building is rigged to blow.
Helene's hand is a vise of terror in yours, her nails biting into your palm.
Her progress is hobbled by her heels. The faint shapes of the group ahead gradually vanish into the gloom as the two of you stumble through a hellscape of crumbling stone.
Now is the moment. This is the perfect cover to steal the deadly letter from her grasp.
